comment.en: On a single run: security 215 of 250, architecture 156 of 200, bugs 147 of 150, performance 128 of 150 and 71 of 100 in clean code, with no penalty. It fixed 33 of the 36 planted flaws and its report was rated 44 of 50. It lost 25 compatibility points for one security change that the manifest does not allow: after 10 failed logins for an e-mail, the login answers 429 even to the right password, a status the manifest does not list, and anyone who knows an e-mail can lock that user out. The run cost US$ 15.81 and took 52 minutes of the agent's own time, without the 18 minutes the operator took between the two stages. One run of three: it is not official and could move.

Perdeu 25 pontos de compatibilidade por uma mudança de segurança que o manifesto não permite: depois de 10 logins errados para um e-mail, o login responde 429 até para a senha certa, um status que o manifesto não lista, e quem souber um e-mail pode trancar aquele usuário para fora. A execução custou US$ 15,81 e levou 52 minutos de tempo do próprio agente, sem os 18 minutos que o operador levou entre as duas etapas. Uma execução de três: não é oficial e pode mudar.

comment.en: Two runs, 134 points apart (897 and 763), so this agent is not steady yet. The first had full marks in security and the best architecture and clean-code scores so far; the second kept security near the top (239 of 250) but fell to 133 of 200 in architecture and 36 of 100 in clean code, while keeping the contract whole (compatibility 100, against 75 in the first). Both runs took the 15-point penalty for introducing a new bug, and the second one cost US$ 2.50 in 31 minutes, against US$ 5.18 in 43. The same model at xhigh effort scored 860 for US$ 6.58. Two runs of three: not official, and the published score is the lower of the two.

As duas levaram a penalidade de 15 pontos por introduzir um bug novo, e a segunda custou US$ 2,50 em 31 minutos, contra US$ 5,18 em 43. O mesmo modelo em xhigh fez 860 por US$ 6,58.
